---
title: "Construct the Diagnosis Dictionary"
subtitle: "Reconcile measurement definitions across Waves 1, 2, 3A, and 3B"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

This page implements `3_construct_dictionary.R` as successive targets. It
preserves the reviewed cross-wave mappings, supplemental diagnoses, wording
corrections, and 40 output-file groups. Wave 3 measurements stay in Parquet:
this stage needs their ordered column schema, not their rows.

Translations come from the archived source translations and the bilingual
`data/clean/diagnosis_dictionary_translated.csv` snapshot in the staged ZIP.
That snapshot supplies language lookups only; its variable IDs and mapping
expressions do not replace the newly constructed dictionary. No translation
service is called.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Upstream Artifacts"}

Page 18 must have produced `s0_clinic_RMA_W3_clean_parquet`, and page 20 must
have selected `s2_clinic_months_raw_zip`. In an authorized R session, confirm
that these tracked files exist. This check reads target metadata and paths,
not the measurement tables.

```{r}
stopifnot(
  all(file.exists(targets::tar_read(s0_clinic_RMA_W3_clean_parquet))),
  all(file.exists(targets::tar_read(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip)))
)
```

Authoring remains globally unevaluated. The helpers below are declared in
procedures because `tar_tangle()` also tracks top-level function assignments.
The procedure declarations are wired into the graph by the execution page.
:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare Archive And Text Helpers"}

Resolve exact archive-member suffixes and extract only the selected input
into a temporary directory. Each reader must return a materialized small
object before extraction cleanup; no temporary path becomes a downstream input.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(duckplyr)
library(targets)

s3_dictionary_archive_member_fn <- function(archive, suffix) {
  members <- utils::unzip(archive, list = TRUE)$Name
  hits <- members[endsWith(members, paste0("/", suffix)) &
                    !grepl("(^|/)__MACOSX/", members)]
  if (length(hits) != 1L) stop("Expected one archive member for: ", suffix)
  unname(hits)
}
```

```{r}
s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn <- function(archive, member, reader) {
  stopifnot(length(member) == 1L, !grepl("^/|(^|/)\\.\\.(/|$)", member))
  extraction_dir <- tempfile("dictionary-input-")
  dir.create(extraction_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(extraction_dir, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  path <- utils::unzip(archive, files = member, exdir = extraction_dir)
  stopifnot(length(path) == 1L, file.exists(path))
  reader(path)
}

s3_dictionary_read_csv_fn <- function(archive, member) {
  s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(archive, member, function(path) {
    read.csv(path, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
}
```

Apply the legacy wording substitutions sequentially. Unequal non-scalar
pattern/replacement vectors fail explicitly instead of calling the legacy
undefined `error()` function.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_multiple_gsub_fn <- function(patterns, replacements, x) {
  if (length(patterns) != length(replacements) &&
      length(patterns) != 1L && length(replacements) != 1L) {
    stop("Pattern and replacement must have equal length or be scalar.")
  }
  count <- max(length(patterns), length(replacements))
  patterns <- rep_len(patterns, count)
  replacements <- rep_len(replacements, count)
  for (i in seq_len(count)) x <- gsub(patterns[[i]], replacements[[i]], x)
  x
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Select The Dictionary Sources"}

The staged ZIP is already a file target. Member names below are selectors
inside that tracked archive, not independent filesystem paths. Select the
current `data/raw` versions explicitly so the parallel review and OLD copies
cannot be chosen accidentally.

```{r}
s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr <- {
  suffixes <- c(
    mapping = "data/raw/diagnosis_mapping/diagnosis_mapping_updated_1march2024_withspecialchar_fixw3b.csv",
    wave12 = "data/raw/diagnosis_mapping/Big Dictionary Revised_with_wave - withID.csv",
    diar_pneu = "data/raw/from_Kevin/mdg_tall_split/diar_pneu_fix.csv",
    additional = "data/raw/from_Kevin/Big Dictionary Revised_v2.xlsx",
    wave3 = "data/raw/diagnosis_mapping/symphonia w3_diagnoses_with_zero_years_MLC_updated_unordered_w3.csv",
    anemia = "data/raw/anemie_2020.csv",
    translations = "data/raw/diagnosis_dictionary_ordered_file_translated.csv",
    archived = "data/clean/diagnosis_dictionary_translated.csv",
    dir1 = "data/raw/from_Kevin/updated_dictionary/dir1_diagnostic_codes.xlsx",
    dir2 = "data/raw/from_Kevin/updated_dictionary/dir2_diagnostic_codes.xlsx"
  )
  vapply(suffixes, function(suffix) {
    s3_dictionary_archive_member_fn(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, suffix)
  }, character(1))
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Record The Ordered Wave 3 Schema"}

Read the prepared Parquet column names without collecting measurements.
Append only anemia columns absent from that schema, after the legacy `?` to
`≥` correction and removal of its two descriptive organisation columns.
Persist this schema as an ordinary target: downstream measurement cleaning
must use these same `X` identifiers rather than inventing another column order.

```{r}
s3_w3_anemia_columns_chr <- s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["anemia"]],
  function(path) {
    columns <- names(read_csv_duckdb(path, prudence = "stingy"))
    columns <- gsub("?", "≥", columns, fixed = TRUE)
    setdiff(columns, c("organisationunitcode", "organisationunitdescription"))
  }
)

s3_w3_column_dictionary_df <- {
  columns <- names(read_parquet_duckdb(
    s0_clinic_RMA_W3_clean_parquet, prudence = "stingy"
  ))
  bind_rows(
    tibble(w3_description = columns, orig = TRUE),
    tibble(w3_description = setdiff(s3_w3_anemia_columns_chr, columns), orig = FALSE)
  ) |>
    mutate(w3_colname = paste0("X", row_number()))
}
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_mapping_source_df <- s3_dictionary_read_csv_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["mapping"]]
) |>
  select(-wave3_colname_orig, -wave3_colname_noAccent)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Tidy The Wave 1–2 Dictionary"}

Retain the legacy diagnostic-code filter and remove the old Wave 1 diarrhea
and pneumonia definitions. `read.csv()` preserves the legacy syntactic column
names, including `ID.`; changing them here would break the reviewed joins.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df <- s3_dictionary_read_csv_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["wave12"]]
) |>
  filter(Diagnostic.Code..cCode. != "") |>
  filter(!(Diagnostic.Code..cCode. %in% c("Diarrhea", "Pneumonia") &
             wave == "Wave 1")) |>
  select(-Column.Type)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Read Replacement Diarrhea And Pneumonia Definitions"}

Reduce the replacement tall CSV in DuckDB to distinct `cCode`/`Variable`
pairs. Preserve first-occurrence order before collecting those definitions;
this order contributes to subsequent variable numbering. The measurement
values are never collected into R.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_diar_pneu_variables_df <- s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["diar_pneu"]],
  function(path) {
    duckplyr::db_exec("INSTALL encodings")
    duckplyr::db_exec("LOAD encodings")
    read_csv_duckdb(path, prudence = "stingy", options = list(
      header = TRUE, delim = ",", quote = "\"", escape = "\"",
      nullstr = "NA", encoding = "CP1252", all_varchar = TRUE
    )) |>
      select(cCode, Variable) |>
      mutate(.source_row = row_number()) |>
      summarise(.source_row = min(.source_row), .by = c(cCode, Variable)) |>
      arrange(.source_row) |>
      select(-.source_row) |>
      collect()
  }
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Add AVC, ULGEN, And Replacement Diagnoses"}

Use the revised workbook only for AVC, because its ordering is unsuitable
for the main reviewed dictionary. Derive ULGEN and the new diarrhea/pneumonia
descriptions from the existing Wave 1 AFDIG templates, as in the legacy script.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_avc_dictionary_df <- s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["additional"]],
  function(path) readxl::read_excel(path)
) |>
  select(-`Column Type`) |>
  setNames(c(names(s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df)[1:4], "drop", "drop1")) |>
  select(-starts_with("drop")) |>
  filter(grepl("^AVC", Diagnostic.Code..cCode.)) |>
  mutate(wave = "Wave 2", ID. = Column.Name)

s3_diagnosis_ulgen_dictionary_df <- s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df |>
  filter(wave == "Wave 1", grepl("^AFDIG", Diagnostic.Code..cCode.)) |>
  mutate(
    Diagnostic.Code..cCode. = "ULGEN",
    Column.Name = gsub("AFDIG", "ULGEN", Column.Name),
    ID. = Column.Name
  )
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_diar_pneu_dictionary_df <- s3_diagnosis_diar_pneu_variables_df |>
  transmute(Column.Name = paste0(cCode, gsub(".*_", "_", Variable)),
            descr_join = gsub(".*_", "_", Variable)) |>
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df |>
    filter(wave == "Wave 1", grepl("^AFDIG", Diagnostic.Code..cCode.)) |>
    mutate(descr_join = gsub(".*_", "_", Column.Name)) |>
    select(-Column.Name), by = "descr_join") |>
  select(-descr_join) |>
  mutate(ID. = Column.Name, Diagnostic.Code..cCode. = gsub("_.*", "", Column.Name))

s3_diagnosis_supplementary_dictionary_df <- bind_rows(
  s3_diagnosis_avc_dictionary_df,
  s3_diagnosis_ulgen_dictionary_df,
  s3_diagnosis_diar_pneu_dictionary_df
)
```

:::

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_wave3_reviewed_df <- s3_dictionary_read_csv_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["wave3"]]
) %>%
mutate(description = case_when(description == "T4:- Anémie 29j - 11mois, Feminin" ~ "T4:- Anémie 29j – 11mois, Feminin",
                                 description == "T4:- Anémie 29j - 11mois, Masculin" ~ "T4:- Anémie 29j – 11mois, Masculin",
                                 .default = description),
         w3b_description = case_when(description == "T4:- Malnutrition Aigue Sévère 29j – 11mois, Masculin" ~ "T4:- Malnutrition Aigue Sévère 29 - 59j, Masculin[+]T4:- Malnutrition Aigue Sévère 2-11m, Masculin",
                                     description == "T4:- Malnutrition Aigue Sévère 29j – 11mois, Feminin" ~ "T4:- Malnutrition Aigue Sévère 29 - 59j, Feminin[+]T4:- Malnutrition Aigue Sévère 2-11m, Feminin",
                                     .default = w3b_description)) %>%
  select(-starts_with("y_"), -X, -OBSERVATION) %>%
  filter(description %in% c("T4:- Suspicion de diabète 29j – 11mois, Masculin", "T4:- Suspicion de diabète 29j – 11mois, Feminin") == FALSE)
```

Append the diabetes replacements, remove explicitly unused matches, and
resolve each `[+]` term against the recorded Wave 3 schema. Keep the reviewed
malnutrition and anemia corrections in the preceding transformation.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_wave3_mapping_df <- bind_rows(
  s3_diagnosis_wave3_reviewed_df, s3_diagnosis_diabetes_review_df
) %>%
filter(w3b_description %in% c("", "unused from 2021") == FALSE) %>%
  left_join(s3_w3_column_dictionary_df %>% select(description = w3_description, w3a_colname = w3_colname)) %>%
  mutate(row_id = 1:n()) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(cols = w3b_description, delim = "[+]") %>%
  left_join(s3_w3_column_dictionary_df %>% select(w3b_description = w3_description, w3b_colname = w3_colname)) %>%
  summarise(across(!starts_with("w3b"), unique),
            w3b_description = paste0(w3b_description, collapse = "[+]"),
            w3b_colname = paste0(w3b_colname, collapse = " + "),
            .by = row_id)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Normalize The Cross-Wave Match Notation"}

Expand slash alternatives and numeric ranges before semicolon expansion.
Retain the legacy ordering: non-range entries precede expanded ranges.
Blank, `?`, and `Ignore` entries have the original missing-match semantics.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_matches_expanded_df <- s3_diagnosis_mapping_source_df %>%
  rename(wave3_description = wave3_colname_specialchar) %>%
  full_join(s3_w3_column_dictionary_df %>% rename_with(~gsub("w3", "wave3", .x)) %>% select(-orig),
            by = c("wave3_description")) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^org|^period", wave3_description)) %>%
  filter(wave3_description %in% c("V1", "TYPE", "FS", "code_fs") == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Wave_1_Match, Wave_2_Match),
                ~ case_match(.x,
                             c("", "?") ~ NA,
                             .default = .x))) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(Wave_1_Match, delim = "/") %>%
  {rbind(filter(., grepl("-", Wave_1_Match) == FALSE),
         filter(., grepl("-", Wave_1_Match) == TRUE) %>%
           rowwise %>%
           mutate(Wave_1_Match = str_split_fixed(Wave_1_Match, "-", 2)[1,] %>% trimws %>% as.numeric %>% {seq(from = .[1], to = .[2])} %>% paste(collapse = ";")) %>%
           ungroup)} %>%
  mutate(row_id = 1:n()) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(Wave_1_Match, delim = ";") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("Match"), ~ifelse(.x == "Ignore", NA, .x)))
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Join Source Definitions And Resolve Wave 3B"}

Join reviewed IDs to the earlier-wave column names and descriptions, then
recombine expanded terms with ` + `. Apply the within-Wave-3 mapping and
retain unchanged Wave 3 columns where no separate 3B definition was provided.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_matches_joined_df <- s3_diagnosis_matches_expanded_df %>%
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df %>%
              rbind(s3_diagnosis_supplementary_dictionary_df) %>%
              transmute(ID. = as.character(ID.),
                        Column.Name, description) %>%
              rename_with(~paste0("wave1_", .x)),
            by = join_by(Wave_1_Match == wave1_ID.)) %>%
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df %>%
              rbind(s3_diagnosis_supplementary_dictionary_df) %>%
              transmute(ID. = as.character(ID.),
                        Column.Name, description) %>%
              rename_with(~paste0("wave2_", .x)),
            by = join_by(Wave_2_Match == wave2_ID.)) %>%
  rename(wave1_colname = wave1_Column.Name,
         wave2_colname = wave2_Column.Name) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~paste(unique(.x), collapse = " + ")),
            .by = row_id) %>%
  select(ends_with(c("_colname", "description")))
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_matches_wave3_df <- s3_diagnosis_matches_joined_df %>%
  rename_with(function(x){gsub("wave3_", "wave3A_", x)}, everything()) %>%
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_wave3_mapping_df %>%
              select(wave3A_colname = w3a_colname,
                     wave3B_colname = w3b_colname,
                     wave3B_description = w3b_description)) %>%
  filter(wave3A_colname %in% na.omit(unique(.$wave3B_colname)) == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(wave3B_colname = ifelse(is.na(wave3B_colname), wave3A_colname, wave3B_colname),
         wave3B_description = ifelse(is.na(wave3B_description), wave3A_description, wave3B_description)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x == "NA", NA, .x)))
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Aggregate Comparable Variables Across Waves"}

The shared reducer retains the legacy missing-component rule: if one
component is unmatched, the aggregate for that other wave is missing.
Repeated source expressions are cleared before retaining the first complete
expression combination. These rules affect comparability and are not replaced
by a generic sum or coalesce.

Select local column names with `all_of()`/`pick()` when the helper runs.
This preserves grouped column lookup while avoiding premature unquotation
when `tar_tangle()` declares the function target.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_aggregate_to_wave_fn <- function(df, target_wave,
                                     all_waves = paste0("wave", c(1:2, "3A", "3B"))) {
  other_waves = setdiff(all_waves, target_wave)
  target_col = paste0(target_wave, "_colname")
  target_desc = paste0(target_wave, "_description")
  other_col = paste0(other_waves, "_colname")
  filter(df, if_any(all_of(target_col), ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
    summarise(description = unique(pick(all_of(target_desc))[[1L]]),
              across(all_of(other_col),
                     ~if(any(is.na(.x))){NA}else{paste(unique(.x), collapse = " + ")}),
              .by = all_of(target_col)) %>%
    mutate(wave1_colname = ifelse(n() == 1, wave1_colname, NA),
           .by = c(wave1_colname)) %>%
    mutate(wave2_colname = ifelse(n() == 1, wave2_colname, NA),
           .by = c(wave2_colname)) %>%
    mutate(wave3A_colname = ifelse(n() == 1, wave3A_colname, NA),
           .by = c(wave3A_colname)) %>%
    mutate(wave3B_colname = ifelse(n() == 1, wave3B_colname, NA),
           .by = c(wave3B_colname)) %>%
    return
}
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_common_map_df <- s3_diagnosis_matches_wave3_df %>%
  {rbind(s3_diagnosis_aggregate_to_wave_fn(., "wave1"),# %>% mutate(target = "wave1"),
         s3_diagnosis_aggregate_to_wave_fn(., "wave2"),# %>% mutate(target = "wave2"),
         s3_diagnosis_aggregate_to_wave_fn(., "wave3A"),# %>% mutate(target = "wave3A"),
         filter(., .$wave3A_colname %in% .$wave3B_colname == FALSE) %>%
           s3_diagnosis_aggregate_to_wave_fn("wave3B")# %>% mutate(target = "wave3B")
         )} %>%
  slice_head(n = 1, by = ends_with("colname"))
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Append Unmatched Earlier-Wave Variables And Assign V IDs"}

Keep unmatched earlier-wave variables except the designated `ONG`/`IGNORE`
categories. Preserve source order when assigning `V1`, `V2`, and subsequent
harmonized IDs. These IDs are independent of the Wave 3 table’s row-index `V1`.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_variable_map_df <- s3_diagnosis_common_map_df %>%
  rbind(s3_diagnosis_wave12_dictionary_df %>%
          filter(Diagnostic.Code..cCode. %in% c("ONG", "IGNORE") == FALSE) %>%
          rbind(s3_diagnosis_supplementary_dictionary_df) %>%
          filter(Column.Name %in% c(s3_diagnosis_common_map_df$wave1_colname, s3_diagnosis_common_map_df$wave2_colname) == FALSE) %>%
          select(colname = Column.Name, description, wave) %>%
          mutate(wave = gsub("Wave ", "wave", wave),
                 id = 1:n()) %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = wave, values_from = colname) %>%
          rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_colname"), starts_with("wave")) %>%
          select(-id) %>%
          mutate(wave3A_colname = NA,
                 wave3B_colname = NA)) %>%
  mutate(var = paste0("V", 1:n())) %>%
  select(var, description, wave1_colname, wave2_colname, wave3A_colname, wave3B_colname)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Reuse The Archived Description Translations"}

Read the original translated descriptions, retain the first translation for
each French description, and apply the legacy wording substitutions. Also
read the frozen bilingual dictionary as a translation cache, with its archive
member recorded in the target dependencies.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_translation_archive_df <- s3_dictionary_read_csv_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["archived"]]
)

s3_diagnosis_translation_provenance_df <- tibble(
  source_archive = s2_clinic_months_raw_zip,
  original_descriptions = s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["translations"]],
  bilingual_snapshot = s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["archived"]],
  method = "Archived French-English pairs; no translation service"
)
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_translations_df <- s3_dictionary_read_csv_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[["translations"]]
) %>%
select(description_fr = description, description_en = Translation.of.Column.B) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1, by = description_fr) %>%
  mutate(description_en = s3_diagnosis_multiple_gsub_fn(c("FAF", "Otitis",
                                          "AME", "CPON",
                                          " ARI", "Hemorrhage \\*",
                                          "Growth Delay", "Traumatic Red Eye"),
                                        c("iron and folic acid", "Ear infection",
                                          "exclusive breastfeeding", "postnatal consultations",
                                          " Acute respiratory infection", "Postpartum hemorrhage",
                                          "Stunting", "Red eye with physical trauma"),
                                        description_en))
```

Build lookup tables from exact French/English pairs. Conflicting archived
translations fail explicitly; they are not resolved by arbitrary row order.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_translation_lookup_fn <- function(data, french, english) {
  pairs <- tibble(french = data[[french]], english = data[[english]]) |>
    filter(!is.na(french), french != "", !is.na(english), english != "") |>
    distinct()
  if (anyDuplicated(pairs$french)) stop("Conflicting archived translations.")
  pairs
}

s3_diagnosis_code_translation_lookup_df <- s3_diagnosis_translation_lookup_fn(
  s3_diagnosis_translation_archive_df,
  "cCode_description_fr", "cCode_description_en"
)

s3_diagnosis_table_translation_lookup_df <- s3_diagnosis_translation_lookup_fn(
  s3_diagnosis_translation_archive_df,
  "wave3_table_desc_fr", "wave3_table_desc_en"
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Read Diagnostic Codes And Retain Reviewed Aliases"}

Only `dir1` and `dir2` contribute to the legacy result. Read those two
workbooks explicitly, attach their wave labels, and keep both original codes
and the reviewed aliases. The repeated `DiSSDH` case retains the original
first-match behavior (`DiSS`); this migration does not invent a `DySS` rule.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_code_dictionary_source_df <- map_dfr(c("dir1", "dir2"), function(directory) {
  s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(
    s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s3_dictionary_archive_members_chr[[directory]],
    function(path) readxl::read_excel(path)
  ) |>
    mutate(file = directory)
})
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_code_aliases_df <- s3_diagnosis_code_dictionary_source_df %>%
  mutate(new_cCode= case_match(cCode,
                                "ASTH" ~ "Asthma",

                                "TIAC" ~ "FoodPoisoning",
                                "ICAM" ~ "Marine",
                                "MORGRIASC" ~ "Bites",
                                "ANEMGRAV" ~ "AnemiaSevere",
                                "ANEMIE" ~ "Anemia",
                                "INSUFPOND" ~ "Underweight",

                                "OBESITE" ~ "Obesity",
                                "RETCROIS" ~ "Stunting",
                                "SUSPGRIP" ~ "Flu",
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_code_dictionary_df <- bind_rows(
  s3_diagnosis_code_aliases_df |> select(-new_cCode),
  s3_diagnosis_code_aliases_df |>
    select(-cCode) |> rename(cCode = new_cCode) |> filter(!is.na(cCode))
)
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Attach Diagnostic-Code Descriptions Across Waves"}

Match each code against the appropriate Wave 1 or Wave 2 expression. Collect
only actual matches instead of constructing the legacy variable-by-code
logical matrix. Then preserve the original within-wave and between-wave
description grouping and ordering.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_code_matches_df <- pmap_dfr(
  s3_diagnosis_code_dictionary_df,
  function(cCode, cDesc, file) {
    wave_column <- switch(file, dir1 = "wave1_colname", dir2 = "wave2_colname",
                          stop("Unexpected diagnostic-code source: ", file))
    matches <- grepl(paste0("^", cCode, "_| ", cCode, "_"),
                     s3_diagnosis_variable_map_df[[wave_column]])
    tibble(diag_var = s3_diagnosis_variable_map_df$var[matches],
           cDesc = cDesc, file = file)
  }
)
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_variable_code_french_df <- s3_diagnosis_code_matches_df |>
  slice_head(n = 1, by = c(diag_var, cDesc)) |>
  mutate(file = paste0(" (", gsub("dir", "wave", file), ")")) |>
  summarise(cDesc_fr = paste(cDesc, collapse = " + "), .by = c(diag_var, file)) |>
  mutate(n_file = n_distinct(file), .by = diag_var) |>
  mutate(cDesc_fr = paste0(cDesc_fr, ifelse(n_file > 1, file, ""))) |>
  summarise(cCode_description_fr = paste(cDesc_fr, collapse = ", "), .by = diag_var)

s3_diagnosis_variable_code_descriptions_df <- s3_diagnosis_variable_code_french_df |>
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_code_translation_lookup_df,
            by = c("cCode_description_fr" = "french")) |>
  rename(cCode_description_en = english)
```

The snapshot stores complete grouped descriptions, so translation is joined
after the code descriptions are assembled. This avoids splitting clinical
phrases on punctuation. Missing grouped translations are reported below and
stop final dictionary construction.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Assemble Descriptions And The Forty Output Groups"}

Join translations by French description and diagnostic-code text by `var`.
Retain the RDT age correction, prepend diagnostic-code context, and derive
wave availability from nonmissing expressions. Keep the original `cut(...,
40)` grouping, which assigns output files without reordering variables.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_dictionary_age_corrected_df <- s3_diagnosis_variable_map_df %>%
  rename(description_fr = description) %>%
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_translations_df, by = "description_fr") %>%
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_variable_code_descriptions_df, by = c(var = "diag_var")) %>%
  mutate(description_fr = ifelse(wave1_colname == "cTDRp_14ap" & description_fr == "Nb TDR (+) 6 - 13 ans",
                                 "Nb TDR (+) 14 ans et plus",
                                 description_fr),
         description_en = ifelse(wave1_colname == "cTDRp_14ap" & description_en == "Number of Positive RDTs in 6-13 Years Age Group",
                                 "Number of Positive RDTs in 14 Years and Older",
                                 description_en))
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_dictionary_described_df <- s3_diagnosis_dictionary_age_corrected_df %>%
  mutate(description_en = ifelse(!is.na(description_en),
                                 paste0(ifelse(!is.na(cCode_description_en),
                                               paste0(cCode_description_en, ", "),
                                               ""),
                                        description_en),
                                 NA),
         waves_available = apply(
           !is.na(across(all_of(paste0("wave", c("1", "2", "3A", "3B"), "_colname")))),
           1, function(present) paste(c("1", "2", "3A", "3B")[present], collapse = ", ")
         )) %>%
  mutate(filename = paste0("file",
                           cut(1:n(), 40) %>% as.factor() %>% as.numeric())) %>%
  select(var,
         waves_available,
         description_en = description_en,
         description_fr = description_fr,
         starts_with("cCode_description"),
         filename,
         ends_with("colname"),
         everything())
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Resolve Wave 3 Descriptions And Reporting Tables"}

Resolve `X` terms back to their recorded descriptions. Keep the distinct
3A/3B wording when the expressions differ. Join reporting-table translations
from the archived snapshot; no fresh network translation is performed.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_wave3_descriptions_df <- s3_diagnosis_dictionary_described_df %>%
  select(var, starts_with("wave3")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("wave3")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(value, delim = " + ") %>%
  left_join(s3_w3_column_dictionary_df %>% select(w3_description, w3_colname),
            by = c("value" = "w3_colname")) %>%
  summarise(across(c(value, w3_description),
                   ~paste(.x, collapse = " + ")),
            .by = c(var, name)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = c(value, w3_description)) %>%
  mutate(w3_description = ifelse(w3_description_wave3A_colname != w3_description_wave3B_colname,
                                 paste0(w3_description_wave3A_colname, " (wave 3A) + ",
                                        w3_description_wave3B_colname, " (wave 3B)"),
                                 paste0(w3_description_wave3A_colname, " (wave3)")),
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  rename_with(~gsub("value_", "", .x))
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Finalize The Dictionary And Report Translation Coverage"}

Retain the two final manual English descriptions. Missing general English
descriptions remain visible as in the archive; missing diagnostic-code or
reporting-table translations indicate that the chosen archived lookup lacks
coverage and must be reviewed before the persisted dictionary is written.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_dictionary_joined_df <- s3_diagnosis_dictionary_described_df %>%
  left_join(s3_diagnosis_wave3_descriptions_enriched_df%>% select(-wave3_table)) %>%
  select(var,
         waves_available,
         description_en = description_en,
         description_fr = description_fr,
         starts_with("cCode_description"),
         filename,
         ends_with("colname"),
         wave3_description = w3_description,
         everything())
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_dictionary_final_df <- s3_diagnosis_dictionary_joined_df %>%
  mutate(description_en = case_when(is.na(description_en) & description_fr == "T4: Oreillon 2-11m, Masculin" ~ "T4: Mumps 2-11 months, Male",
                                    is.na(description_en) & description_fr == "Nombre de jours de fonctionnalité du réfrigérateur dans le mois" ~ "Number of days of refrigerator functionality in the month",
                                    T ~ description_en))
```

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_translation_gaps_df <- bind_rows(
  s3_diagnosis_dictionary_final_df |>
    filter(!is.na(cCode_description_fr), is.na(cCode_description_en)) |>
    transmute(var, field = "diagnostic_code", french = cCode_description_fr),
  s3_diagnosis_dictionary_final_df |>
    filter(!is.na(wave3_table_desc_fr), is.na(wave3_table_desc_en)) |>
    transmute(var, field = "reporting_table", french = wave3_table_desc_fr)
)

s3_diagnosis_dictionary_df <- {
  if (nrow(s3_diagnosis_translation_gaps_df)) {
    stop("Archived translation coverage is incomplete; inspect s3_diagnosis_translation_gaps_df.")
  }
  s3_diagnosis_dictionary_final_df
}
```

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare Validation And Artifact Inspection Helpers"}

Validate the source-expression contract without evaluating expressions as R
code. Report reused complete expressions, repeated summands, and terms absent
from the corresponding source schema. Missing expressions remain allowed;
they indicate that a comparable definition is unavailable in that wave.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_validate_fn <- function(dictionary, wave3_schema, wave12_dictionary) {
  empty <- tibble(var = character(), wave = character(), issue = character(),
                  expression = character())
  issues <- list(empty)
  for (wave in c("wave1", "wave2", "wave3A", "wave3B")) {
    expressions <- dictionary[[paste0(wave, "_colname")]]
    columns <- if (wave %in% c("wave1", "wave2")) {
      wave12_dictionary$Column.Name
    } else wave3_schema$w3_colname
    reused <- duplicated(expressions) | duplicated(expressions, fromLast = TRUE)
    for (i in which(!is.na(expressions))) {
      terms <- strsplit(expressions[[i]], " + ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      problems <- c(if (reused[[i]]) "reused_expression",
                    if (anyDuplicated(terms)) "repeated_summand",
                    if (any(!terms %in% columns)) "unknown_source_column")
      if (length(problems)) issues[[length(issues) + 1L]] <- tibble(
        var = dictionary$var[[i]], wave = wave,
        issue = problems, expression = expressions[[i]]
      )
    }
  }
  bind_rows(issues)
}
```

The artifact inspector asks DuckDB for a scalar count and reads the file size
from filesystem metadata. It never collects the dictionary rows, or the
upstream Wave 3 measurement table.

```{r}
s3_diagnosis_parquet_stats_fn <- function(path) {
  stopifnot(length(path) == 1L, file.exists(path))
  relation <- read_parquet_duckdb(path, prudence = "stingy")
  counts <- relation |> summarise(rows = n()) |> collect()
  tibble(file = basename(path), bytes = unname(file.info(path)$size),
         rows = counts$rows, columns = length(names(relation)))
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Persist The Small Dictionary As A Tracked Parquet File"}

`targets` stores the small in-memory dictionary in its normal R object store
(RDS by default). Write one Parquet file target for disk-based handoffs.
The output path replaces the legacy scratch CSV; no second cleaning route
or standalone RDS export is introduced.

```{r}
#| format: file
s3_diagnosis_dictionary_parquet <- {
  path <- here::here("data", "intermediates", "diagnosis_dictionary_translated.parquet")
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  compute_parquet(as_duckdb_tibble(s3_diagnosis_dictionary_df), path)
  path
}
```

**Review note (2026-11-08).** The researcher reports that the initial
shape checks on pages 18–21 appear to pass. This covers the inspected dimensions, column layout, and variable-count summaries.
This is a researcher-reported observation from the interactive review,
not an independently rerun acceptance test. It does not establish
key-level equality, measurement-value parity, or unchanged diagnosis
definitions/IDs. Retain any remaining discrepancies for review.

Run these chunks in order from the repository root after the targets build.
These are exploratory summaries; interpretation is left to the reader.
[Most recent archived data baseline](mapping/legacy-pipeline-map.qmd#most-recent-archived-data-comparison-baseline)
records the selected iterations, evidence, and provenance limits. The shared
selection is versioned in `src/archived-comparison-baseline.R`.

Use the May 3 clean dictionary inside the selected ZIP, the most recent
archived dictionary data within this freeze. Its SHA-256 matches script 3’s
`scratch/dictionary_test2.csv`. Later Drive iterations are excluded.

Load the pair for this page. Braces keep these session assignments out of
`tar_tangle()`; the objects remain available for interactive exploration.

```{r}
{
  archived_baseline <- dget(here::here("src", "archived-comparison-baseline.R"))
  old_dictionary <- read.csv(unz(
    here::here(archived_baseline$archive_zip), archived_baseline$dictionary_member
  ), check.names = FALSE)
  new_dictionary <- targets::tar_read(s3_diagnosis_dictionary_df)
}
```

**Rows and columns.**

```{r}
tibble::tibble(
  source = c("most recent archived data", "current pipeline"),
  rows = c(nrow(old_dictionary), nrow(new_dictionary)),
  columns = c(ncol(old_dictionary), ncol(new_dictionary))
)
```

**Column names and order.**

```{r}
dplyr::bind_rows(
  `most recent archived data` = tibble::tibble(position = seq_len(ncol(old_dictionary)), column = names(old_dictionary)),
  `current pipeline` = tibble::tibble(position = seq_len(ncol(new_dictionary)), column = names(new_dictionary)),
  .id = "source"
)
```

**Variable counts by output group and available waves.**

```{r}
# Shape check: dictionary-groups
dplyr::bind_rows(
  `most recent archived data` = old_dictionary |> dplyr::count(filename, waves_available, name = "variables"),
  `current pipeline` = new_dictionary |> dplyr::count(filename, waves_available, name = "variables"),
  .id = "source"
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(filename, waves_available), names_from = source,
    values_from = variables, values_fill = 0L
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(difference = `current pipeline` - `most recent archived data`) |>
  dplyr::arrange(readr::parse_number(filename), waves_available) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

An absent group contributes zero variables. Matching group sizes do not prove
that the same clinical definitions carry the same `V` IDs.
